title: Transition-compatible target comparison from finite-stage inclusion cones
statement: Let I be a directed preorder and SX,SY,SZ stage systems of categories A_i,B_i,C_i with pair categories PX,PY,PZ and inclusions IX_i,IY_i,IZ_i. Let F:PX→PY and G:PX→PZ be functors, P:SZ.Morphism SY a coherent stage morphism, and Ai:A_i→B_i, Bi:A_i→C_i finite families with transition isomorphisms βA:Ai;TY≅TX;Aj and βB:Bi;TZ≅TX;Bj. Suppose inclusion cones a_i:Ai;IY_i≅IX_i;F and b_i:Bi;IZ_i≅IX_i;G satisfy the component equations IY_j(βA);a_j(TX K)=τY(Ai K);a_i(K);F(τX⁻¹(K)) and IZ_j(βB);b_j(TX K)=τZ(Bi K);b_i(K);G(τX⁻¹(K)). If r_i:Ai≅Bi;P_i satisfies TY(r_i);βP(Bi K);P_j(βB)=βA;r_j(TX K), then there exist q_i:IX_i;F≅IX_i;(G;P.functor) satisfying F(τX⁻¹(K));q_j(TX K)=q_i(K);(G;P.functor)(τX⁻¹(K)) for every i≤j and K∈A_i. Here τ are the stage-system transition inclusions, and the native stage-morphism functor and its inclusion comparison are the standard pair-category API underlying lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent. No faithfulness, exactness, units or additional coherence on Ai and Bi is assumed.

proof.text: Define q_i as the inverse of a_i, followed by the inclusion of r_i, the inverse of P.ιCompFunctorIso, and b_i whiskered by P.functor, with the functor associators retained. This is a literal composite of natural isomorphisms.

Compute P.functor applied to the source transition. Represent the transition and its target inclusion at j, use functor_map_mkHom and mkHom_comp_mkHom, and apply P.coh with the second inequality j≤j. Compose with the two associator inverses and the reflexive β inverse. Functoriality and inverse cancellation give IY_j(βP)=τY(P_i K);P.functor(τZ⁻¹(K)). The identities defining ιCompFunctorIso give the corresponding square with inclusion comparison components.

Precompose the desired equality by the isomorphism τY(Ai K);a_i(K). The a-cone equation cancels the inverse a_j factor. Move the included scalar square r through IY_j using functoriality. Naturality of the j-th pullback inclusion comparison moves βB past that comparison; apply the pullback square from the previous step. Naturality of τY moves r_i, and the b-cone equation identifies the remaining factors. Inverse cancellation finishes. This proves the family compatibility without any use of quotient faithfulness or coherence on βA,βB.

theorem assembleTargetComparison
    {I : Type*} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    {A : I → Type*} [∀ i, Category (A i)]
    {B : I → Type*} [∀ i, Category (B i)]
    {C : I → Type*} [∀ i, Category (C i)]
    (SX : StageSystem A) (SY : StageSystem B) (SZ : StageSystem C)
    (F : SX.PairCategory ⥤ SY.PairCategory) (G : SX.PairCategory ⥤ SZ.PairCategory)
    (P : SZ.Morphism SY) (Ai : ∀ i, A i ⥤ B i) (Bi : ∀ i, A i ⥤ C i)
    (bA : ∀ {i j}, (h : i ≤ j) → Ai i ⋙ SY.T h ≅ SX.T h ⋙ Ai j)
    (bB : ∀ {i j}, (h : i ≤ j) → Bi i ⋙ SZ.T h ≅ SX.T h ⋙ Bi j)
    (a : ∀ i, Ai i ⋙ SY.ι i ≅ SX.ι i ⋙ F)
    (b : ∀ i, Bi i ⋙ SZ.ι i ≅ SX.ι i ⋙ G)
    (hA : ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j) K,
      (SY.ι j).map ((bA h).hom.app K) ≫ (a j).hom.app ((SX.T h).obj K) =
        (SY.transIso h).hom.app ((Ai i).obj K) ≫ (a i).hom.app K ≫
          F.map ((SX.transIso h).inv.app K))
    (hB : ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j) K,
      (SZ.ι j).map ((bB h).hom.app K) ≫ (b j).hom.app ((SX.T h).obj K) =
        (SZ.transIso h).hom.app ((Bi i).obj K) ≫ (b i).hom.app K ≫
          G.map ((SX.transIso h).inv.app K))
    (r : ∀ i, Ai i ≅ Bi i ⋙ P.Φ i)
    (hr : ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j) K,
      (SY.T h).map ((r i).hom.app K) ≫ (P.β h).hom.app ((Bi i).obj K) ≫
        (P.Φ j).map ((bB h).hom.app K) =
          (bA h).hom.app K ≫ (r j).hom.app ((SX.T h).obj K)) :
    ∃ q : ∀ i, SX.ι i ⋙ F ≅ SX.ι i ⋙ (G ⋙ P.functor),
      ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j) K,
        F.map ((SX.transIso h).inv.app K) ≫ (q j).hom.app ((SX.T h).obj K) =
          (q i).hom.app K ≫ (G ⋙ P.functor).map ((SX.transIso h).inv.app K)
